model_selection.summary: The CLI can select a model, but available identifiers depend on account and policy.

current_session.detail: The interactive CLI can change among models available to the account.

launcher.detail: The launcher can pass a model identifier from the active catalog.

reasoning_effort.summary: Reasoning controls are model/version dependent and are not portable across Copilot surfaces.

current_session.detail: The selected CLI model may expose a reasoning level.

launcher.detail: A launcher can request a supported reasoning level only after negotiating the model.

parallel_agents.summary: CLI subagents and Fleet provide parallelism; plan and version limits apply.

current_session.detail: The CLI can run background/nested subagents or Fleet where available.

launcher.detail: A launcher can request bounded CLI parallelism subject to plan limits.

agent_roles.summary: CLI custom agents can declare role instructions and tools.

current_session.detail: Configured custom agents can be selected during CLI work.

launcher.detail: Repository or user agent definitions provide native role profiles.

context_budget.summary: PowerKit can scope discovery, but Copilot does not publish a portable per-task repository-context hard cap.

current_session.detail: PowerKit controls its own reads and summaries only.

launcher.detail: No portable hard context-budget setting is documented.

tool_restriction.summary: CLI availability filters and allow/deny policies restrict tools; surface semantics differ.

current_session.detail: The active CLI inventory is established; custom subagents can expose narrower tools.

launcher.detail: Launch and agent policy can filter available tools and deny operations.

filesystem_scope.summary: The CLI local sandbox is experimental; without it, tools run with host-user authority.

current_session.detail: Tool policy is available, but a running unsandboxed session cannot become a strong filesystem boundary.

launcher.detail: A launcher can opt into the experimental sandbox and tool policy.

network_restriction.summary: The experimental local sandbox can restrict network; an ordinary CLI process retains host-user networking.

current_session.detail: No global network guarantee exists unless the session started inside the sandbox.

launcher.detail: A launcher can opt into local/cloud sandbox policy, subject to documented exclusions.

shell_restriction.summary: Tool availability and allow/deny policy can constrain shell use; OS isolation depends on sandbox mode.

current_session.detail: The active session can require approvals or avoid the shell, but its tool inventory is already loaded.

launcher.detail: Launch policy can exclude or deny shell tools.

max_iterations.summary: No documented Copilot CLI maximum-turn counter exists.

current_session.detail: PowerKit can count workflow phases but cannot hard-cap CLI turns.

launcher.detail: An outer harness can time out or cancel the session.

checkpoints.summary: Permission modes and hooks can gate concrete tool events; timeouts may fail open on some paths.

current_session.detail: Hooks and assisted mode can gate supported actions, not every semantic milestone.

launcher.detail: Launch permissions and reviewed hooks provide partial action checkpoints.

execution_isolation.summary: Experimental worktree/local/cloud sandboxes exist; their availability and guarantees vary.

current_session.detail: A running root session cannot be retroactively moved into a fresh sandbox.

launcher.detail: A launcher can opt into documented sandbox/worktree modes.

runtime_browser.summary: Shell tests are native; browser testing generally requires Playwright/Puppeteer MCP.

current_session.detail: Runtime tests work; browser behavior depends on explicitly available MCP tools.

launcher.detail: A launcher can configure a browser MCP, with no portable built-in-browser guarantee.

usage_telemetry.summary: Opt-in OpenTelemetry exists; session synchronization and service retention are separate.

current_session.detail: Capture only events emitted by the configured CLI.

launcher.detail: A launcher can configure OTel but cannot control GitHub service retention.

external_write_gating.summary: Tool permissions and hooks gate known operations; no task tier grants external authority.

current_session.detail: Known tool calls can require approval or be denied; external authorization remains separate.

launcher.detail: Launch policy can gate declared tools, not arbitrary side effects.

mcp_restriction.summary: Server/tool filters and registry policy exist, with surface and preview limitations.

current_session.detail: The active CLI uses its loaded MCP set; PowerKit can restrict selection behavior.

launcher.detail: Launch and agent configuration can filter MCP servers and tools.

translations.note: Emitted only when adapter_overrides.copilot.model_tiers names an account-approved model.

cli.label: Copilot CLI
cli.validation_detail: No Copilot CLI was installed in the validation environment on 2026-08-17; this surface is documentation-backed only.

ide.label: IDE agent mode
ide.validation_detail: Documentation-backed only in this release; no automated IDE session was available.

model_selection.summary: Model pickers and policy are client dependent.

current_session.detail: Some IDEs expose a picker; PowerKit cannot assume the selection API.

launcher.detail: No portable cross-IDE launcher model contract exists.

parallel_agents.summary: VS Code supports subagents; other IDE surfaces vary.

current_session.detail: Parallel agents are client dependent.

launcher.detail: No portable cross-IDE concurrency cap exists.

filesystem_scope.summary: No portable IDE OS-sandbox contract is documented.

current_session.detail: IDE tool UI and host process permissions are not a PowerKit filesystem boundary.

launcher.detail: Use an external sandbox when hard filesystem isolation is required.

network_restriction.summary: No portable cross-IDE network sandbox is documented.

current_session.detail: IDE permissions do not prove an OS network boundary.

launcher.detail: Use external isolation for a hard no-network requirement.

execution_isolation.summary: No portable IDE task-isolation guarantee exists.

current_session.detail: The active IDE workspace is not an isolated task environment.

launcher.detail: External worktree/container orchestration is required.

coding-agent.label: hosted coding agent
coding-agent.validation_detail: Documentation-backed only in this release; no hosted coding-agent task was launched.

parallel_agents.summary: GitHub's surface matrix does not promise coding-agent subagents or a per-task concurrency setting.

current_session.detail: Custom personas do not prove nested parallel subagent execution.

launcher.detail: No per-task agent-team control is documented.

filesystem_scope.summary: Hosted tasks use ephemeral runners; tool permissions inside the runner remain broad.

current_session.detail: The runner is ephemeral, but PowerKit does not define every writable path.

launcher.detail: Repository and environment configuration shape the hosted runner.

network_restriction.summary: The hosted firewall has documented bypasses for setup steps and MCP servers.

current_session.detail: The firewall does not cover every setup or MCP transport.

launcher.detail: Repository firewall configuration is native but not a universal no-network boundary.

execution_isolation.summary: Hosted tasks receive an ephemeral runner; self-hosted runner hardening remains operator-owned.

current_session.detail: The hosted task runs in its ephemeral runner.

launcher.detail: Hosted task launch creates the runner; this does not cover self-hosted environments.

runtime_browser.summary: The hosted coding agent supplies Playwright MCP with localhost-oriented constraints.

current_session.detail: Playwright MCP is available in the hosted environment subject to its restrictions.

launcher.detail: The hosted task environment supplies the documented browser tool.

sdk.label: Copilot SDK
sdk.validation_detail: Documentation-backed only in this release; no embedding application was available for runtime validation.

model_selection.summary: SDK sessions can select and change models.

current_session.detail: The application can select the session model.

launcher.detail: The application owns SDK session creation.

current_session.detail: The application may use experimental Fleet APIs.

launcher.detail: The application can orchestrate parallel sessions with preview APIs.

tool_restriction.summary: SDK sessions can expose/exclude tools and apply hook policy.

current_session.detail: The application owns the available tool set.

launcher.detail: SDK session creation can deny by default and attach hooks.

filesystem_scope.summary: The SDK controls tools, while process/container isolation remains application-owned.

current_session.detail: The embedding application must enforce filesystem isolation.

launcher.detail: Use application process/container policy plus tool hooks.

network_restriction.summary: Hook policy can deny tools; network isolation remains application/container responsibility.

current_session.detail: The embedding application must account for process, MCP, and provider networking.

launcher.detail: Use external network policy plus SDK tool/MCP restrictions.

checkpoints.summary: SDK lifecycle and tool hooks can implement application-owned checkpoints.

current_session.detail: The embedding application can block tool events and request a decision.

launcher.detail: Checkpoint state belongs to the SDK application.

usage_telemetry.summary: The SDK supports OpenTelemetry integration for application-observed events.

current_session.detail: The application can capture emitted SDK telemetry.

launcher.detail: The application configures its OTel pipeline.

mcp_restriction.summary: The SDK can configure MCP servers and tool allowlists.

current_session.detail: The application owns the session's MCP inventory.

launcher.detail: SDK session creation can restrict MCP tools.
